description: Create SmartProductService with 7 algorithmic product-fetching methods. Service implements: most_viewed (ec_products.views DESC), most_sold (SUM qty from ec_order_product where order status COMPLETED), trending (views + orders weighted over last 7 days), most_wishlisted (COUNT from ec_wish_lists), best_rated (AVG reviews_avg * reviews_count weight), most_added_to_cart (from Cart::instance('cart') session data - note: no persistent cart table, use views as proxy), similar_products (same category + price range ±20%). All methods filter: status=PUBLISHED, is_variation=0, store approved (if marketplace plugin active). Service namespace: Botble\Ecommerce\Services\Products\SmartProductService. Constructor accepts ProductInterface repository. Returns Collection with eager-loaded relations via EcommerceHelper::withProductEagerLoadingRelations() plus reviews_avg, reviews_count, store.
steps: Implement getMostViewed(int $limit, ?int $categoryId): orders by ec_products.views DESC, applies filters
Implement getMostSold(int $limit, ?int $categoryId): joins ec_order_product, sums qty where ec_orders.status IN (COMPLETED), groups by product_id, orders by total_sold DESC
Implement getTrending(int $limit, ?int $categoryId, int $days = 7): calculates score = (views_last_N_days * 2) + (orders_last_N_days * 10), orders by score DESC
Implement getMostWishlisted(int $limit, ?int $categoryId): joins ec_wish_lists, counts per product_id, orders by wishlist_count DESC
Implement getBestRated(int $limit, ?int $categoryId): orders by (reviews_avg * LOG(reviews_count + 1)) DESC to weight popular + highly-rated

Implement getMostAddedToCart(int $limit, ?int $categoryId): since no persistent cart table exists, use views as proxy - orders by views DESC (same as getMostViewed but separate method for semantic clarity)
Implement getSimilarProducts(int $productId, int $limit): finds products in same category, price within ±20% of reference product's front_sale_price, excludes the reference product itself
Each method applies base query filters: wherePublished(), where('is_variation', 0), if marketplace plugin active: join to ec_stores filtering store status approved
Each method applies optional categoryId filter if provided: join ec_product_categories on ec_products.id = ec_product_categories.product_id where category_id = ?
Add multivendor safety check helper method: protected function applyMultivendorFilter(Builder $query): Builder - checks if marketplace plugin active, joins ec_stores, filters store.status = published
acceptance_criteria: All 7 public methods return Collection of Product models
getMostSold joins ec_order_product correctly and filters by OrderStatusEnum::COMPLETED
getTrending calculates weighted score over configurable days parameter
getMostWishlisted joins ec_wish_lists and counts correctly
getBestRated applies logarithmic weighting to balance rating quality with review quantity
All methods exclude variations (is_variation=0) and unpublished products
categoryId parameter filters to specific category when provided, fetches from all categories when null
Multivendor safety: only products from approved stores appear if marketplace plugin active
verification: php artisan tinker: $service->getMostSold(5); - returns Collection of products with actual orders
php artisan tinker: $service->getTrending(5, null, 7); - returns Collection ordered by trending score
Check each method excludes is_variation=1 products: $service->getMostViewed(100)->filter(fn($p) => $p->is_variation == 1)->isEmpty() should be true
Verify store filter if marketplace active: $service->getMostViewed(100)->filter(fn($p) => $p->store && $p->store->status != 'published')->isEmpty() should be true
